description: Full-stack task board: Next.js frontend, NestJS API, PostgreSQL, Docker, with registration, login, and per-user task management.

tasks.title: Scaffold the NestJS API service and wire Postgres into the stack
tasks.description: Scaffold the NestJS api repo (TypeScript) with Prisma and PostgreSQL, add a health endpoint and a multi-stage Dockerfile, and bring up postgres + api via the workspace docker-compose.
acceptanceCriteria: The api repo builds and boots; GET /api/v1/health returns 200 with a status payload.
Prisma is configured against PostgreSQL and connects on startup.
The api Dockerfile builds a multi-stage, non-root image.
docker compose up brings up postgres and api, with api waiting for db health before starting.
The project's lint, type-check, and build commands pass.
tasks.notes: NestJS 11 (TypeScript, CommonJS) api repo scaffolded with Prisma 6 + PostgreSQL. GET /api/v1/health returns 200 {"status":"ok","uptime","timestamp"}. PrismaService connects on startup (log: 'Connected to PostgreSQL via Prisma'). Multi-stage Dockerfile runs as non-root uid/gid 1001 (api) with a HEALTHCHECK; compose gates api on db health then runs 'npx prisma migrate deploy && node dist/main.js'. Validation in api/: npm run build, typecheck, lint, test (1 passed), test:e2e (2 passed), format:check all pass; docker compose up db+api -> db healthy then api starts, curl localhost:3001/api/v1/health -> 200; container uid=1001(api). api commit 227bb2a on branch ralph/task-001-api-scaffold. Note: latest Nest CLI scaffold (Nest 12/TS 6/vitest) failed to npm-install (Arborist peer crash); pinned stable Nest 11/TS 5.9/Prisma 6/Jest. Prisma schema has no models yet by design (TASK-002 adds User).

tasks.title: Add the user account data model
tasks.description: Add the Prisma User model (unique email, name, passwordHash, timestamps) and the migration required by authentication.
acceptanceCriteria: The User model stores a unique email and a password hash.
The migration applies and rolls back successfully.
A duplicate email is rejected at the database level.
Relevant model and migration tests pass.
tasks.notes: Prisma User model (id uuid @default(uuid()), email unique, name, passwordHash, createdAt @default(now()), updatedAt @updatedAt) in api/prisma/schema.prisma; migration 20261012235230_add_user_model (CreateTable "User" + unique index "User_email_key"). Tests: api/test/user.db-spec.ts under test/jest-db.json, run via `npm run test:db` (prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed then jest --runInBand) -> 5 passed. Coverage: User table + migration recorded in _prisma_migrations, field storage, duplicate email rejected with Prisma P2002 at the DB level, updatedAt advances, correct error type. Rollback/apply verified: migrate reset drops + reapplies; `prisma migrate deploy` applies cleanly on a fresh empty DB (columns/index confirmed via psql \d). All api checks pass: npm run build, typecheck, lint, test (1), test:e2e (2), format:check. api commit 4e2fda74447fae1af9d4003b520d0b3ad08ee0e3 on branch ralph/task-002-user-model. Note: test:db needs DATABASE_URL and NODE_ENV=development and WIPES the target DB (it runs migrate reset); verified against a throwaway postgres:17-alpine on host port 55432 since 5432 is held by an unrelated container. id has no DB-level default (uuid generated by Prisma client).

tasks.title: Implement registration and login authentication
tasks.description: Implement register, login, refresh, logout, and me endpoints using JWT access tokens, a refresh cookie, and bcrypt password hashing.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid registration creates a user with a bcrypt password hash and never returns the hash.
Valid credentials return an access token and set a refresh cookie.
Invalid credentials return 401 without revealing which field was wrong.
POST /auth/refresh issues a new access token from a valid refresh cookie.
GET /auth/me returns the authenticated user's profile.
Authentication e2e tests pass.
tasks.notes: Auth module: POST /auth/register (201) stores a bcrypt cost-12 hash and returns {user, accessToken} plus an httpOnly refresh_token cookie (path /api/v1/auth, 7d); passwordHash is never returned. POST /auth/login (200) returns an access token + cookie; a wrong password and an unknown email both return 401 'Invalid email or password'. POST /auth/refresh (200) verifies the refresh JWT from the cookie and issues a new access token (missing/invalid -> 401). POST /auth/logout (200) clears the cookie. GET /auth/me (200) returns the profile from a Bearer token (missing/invalid -> 401). Added @nestjs/jwt@11 (v12 is ESM-only and breaks the CommonJS/Jest build), bcrypt, cookie-parser, class-validator/class-transformer with a global ValidationPipe. Tests: src/auth/auth.service.spec.ts (unit) and test/auth.e2e-spec.ts (e2e, Prisma mocked in-memory). All api checks pass: npm run build, typecheck, lint, test (7), test:e2e (12), format:check. Also verified against a throwaway postgres:17-alpine (host 55432): `prisma migrate deploy` applied, then curl register/login/refresh/me/logout -> 201/200/200/200/200, invalid creds 401 (identical message), duplicate email 409, no token 401; DB row stored a $2b$ 60-char hash (not plaintext). Fixed a latent build bug: tsconfig.build.json now sets tsBuildInfoFile into ./dist so deleteOutDir + incremental no longer leave a partial dist on repeat builds. Cookie Secure flag is controlled by the explicit COOKIE_SECURE env (default false) instead of NODE_ENV, so tests are environment-independent. api commit 028d4e1d98760f3796609299435370d65db0144b on branch ralph/task-003-auth.

tasks.title: Add the JWT auth guard and current-user decorator
tasks.description: Add a reusable JWT guard and a @CurrentUser() decorator so protected routes resolve the authenticated user.
acceptanceCriteria: Requests without a valid bearer token to a protected route are rejected with 401.
The @CurrentUser() decorator resolves the authenticated user id.
Guard behaviour is covered by tests.
tasks.notes: Added AuthGuard (api/src/auth/guards/auth.guard.ts): reads the Bearer token, verifies it with JwtService, attaches { id, email } to request.user, and throws UnauthorizedException (401) for a missing, non-bearer, or invalid token. Added @CurrentUser() + exported currentUserFactory (api/src/auth/decorators/current-user.decorator.ts) resolving the authenticated user; shared types in api/src/auth/auth.types.ts (AccessTokenPayload, AuthenticatedUser). /auth/me now uses @UseGuards(AuthGuard) + @CurrentUser() and AuthService.getProfile(userId) loads by id (no longer parses the token). AuthModule provides and exports AuthGuard + JwtModule so later feature modules (TASK-006) can guard their controllers. Tests: src/auth/guards/auth.guard.spec.ts (4: missing header / non-bearer / invalid token -> 401, valid token -> true + user attached) and src/auth/decorators/current-user.decorator.spec.ts (1); updated auth.service.spec.ts for getProfile(userId). Validation in api/: npm run format:check, lint, typecheck, build all PASS; npm test -> 13 passed (4 suites); npm run test:e2e -> 12 passed (auth e2e strengthened: /auth/me body.id === registered user id). api commit b794111ffa54ac2dd6a7cf3e4ebf582a75a0baf8 on branch ralph/task-004-auth-guard.

tasks.title: Create the task data model
tasks.description: Add the Prisma Task model (title, optional description, due date, completed, owner relation, timestamps, indexes) and its migration.
acceptanceCriteria: A Task stores a title, optional description, optional due date, completion state, owner, and timestamps.
Deleting a user cascades to their tasks.
Indexes support listing tasks by owner and completion state.
The migration and model tests pass.
tasks.notes: Prisma Task model added (api/prisma/schema.prisma): id uuid @default(uuid()), title String, description String?, dueDate DateTime?, completed Boolean @default(false), ownerId + owner User relation (onDelete: Cascade), createdAt @default(now()), updatedAt @updatedAt; composite @@index([ownerId, completed]) and @@index([ownerId, createdAt]). Migration 20261013000358_add_task_model: CREATE TABLE "Task", FK Task_ownerId_fkey ON DELETE CASCADE, INDEX Task_ownerId_completed_idx (ownerId,completed) + Task_ownerId_createdAt_idx (ownerId,createdAt). Tests: api/test/task.db-spec.ts (7) under test/jest-db.json, run via `npm run test:db` -> 12 passed (7 task + 5 user); covers Task table + migration recorded, full field storage, completed default false + nullable description/dueDate, cascade delete (deleting the user removes their tasks), index presence via pg_indexes, listing by owner + completed filter, updatedAt advance. `prisma migrate reset` (test:db) verifies rollback + reapply. All api checks pass: npm run build, typecheck, lint, test (13), test:e2e (12), format:check. api commit aa8bfe3 on branch ralph/task-005-task-model. Note: test:db needs DATABASE_URL + NODE_ENV=development and wipes the target DB; verified against a throwaway postgres:17-alpine on host port 55432 since 5432 is held by an unrelated container. Task.id has no DB-level default (uuid generated by the Prisma client), matching User.

tasks.title: Implement per-user task CRUD endpoints
tasks.description: Implement create, paginated list, get, update, and delete endpoints for tasks, scoped to the authenticated user's own tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: An authenticated user can create, list, read, update, and delete their own tasks.
A user cannot read, update, or delete another user's task (returns 404).
The list endpoint supports pagination and filtering by completion state.
Invalid input returns a structured 400 validation error.
Task CRUD e2e tests pass.
tasks.notes: TasksModule (api/src/tasks): POST /tasks (201), GET /tasks (200), GET /tasks/:id (200), PATCH /tasks/:id (200), DELETE /tasks/:id (204), all under @Controller('tasks') with @UseGuards(AuthGuard) and scoped to @CurrentUser().id. Ownership via TasksService.findOwnedTask (prisma.task.findFirst where { id, ownerId }) -> NotFoundException('Task not found') 404 for another user's task on read/update/delete; cross-user list returns only the owner's tasks. List supports page (default 1) + limit (default 20, max 100) via ListTasksQueryDto (@Type Number) and completed filter (Transform 'true'/'false' -> boolean), ordered createdAt desc, returns { data, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }. DTOs (create/update) validate title (1..200) + optional description (<=2000), dueDate (ISO-8601), completed (boolean); global ValidationPipe (whitelist/forbidNonWhitelisted/transform) yields structured 400 { statusCode, message: [...] }. TasksModule imports AuthModule (exports AuthGuard); AppModule registers TasksModule. Tests: src/tasks/tasks.service.spec.ts (10) and test/tasks.e2e-spec.ts (8, in-memory Prisma mock): auth required (401), create ownerId, structured 400 (empty title + limit>100), list ownership isolation + pagination meta + completed filter, read/update/delete own task, another user's task -> 404 on read/update/delete while owner still sees it, delete then 404. Validation in api/: npm run format:check, lint, typecheck, build PASS; npm test -> 23 passed (5 suites); npm run test:e2e -> 20 passed (3 suites). Real-Postgres smoke (throwaway postgres:17-alpine host port 55432; migrate deploy applied both migrations; API on 3002): register x2 -> create 4 (201) -> list default/page=1&limit=2/completed=true -> get 200 -> patch 200 -> bob read/patch/delete ada task 404 -> bob list 0 -> delete 204 -> get 404 -> empty title 400 -> limit=1000 400 -> no auth 401; psql shows 3 remaining Ada-owned tasks after deletion. api commit 0b1f946646206ac2e0cd7c4b33fd05a741131c16 on branch ralph/task-006-task-crud.

tasks.title: Standardize API responses, errors, and documentation
tasks.description: Add the global response interceptor, global exception filter, startup env validation, and OpenAPI/Swagger docs, and document the API in the repo README.
acceptanceCriteria: Success responses share one envelope and errors share one structure.
Startup fails fast with a clear message when a required env var is missing.
Swagger UI is served and describes all endpoints.
The API README documents how to run, configure, and test the service.
tasks.notes: Global response envelope + error shape via APP_INTERCEPTOR/APP_FILTER registered in AppModule (so they also apply in tests): ResponseInterceptor wraps 2xx as { success:true, statusCode, data } (no body for 204); AllExceptionsFilter normalizes every error to { success:false, statusCode, error, message, path } and maps unexpected errors to a 500 without leaking internals. Files: api/src/common/api-response.ts, api/src/common/interceptors/response.interceptor.ts (+spec), api/src/common/filters/all-exceptions.filter.ts (+spec). Startup env validation: api/src/config/env.validation.ts validateEnv() requires DATABASE_URL + JWT_SECRET and validates PORT, called in main.ts bootstrap which now logs the error and process.exit(1) on failure (+spec). OpenAPI/Swagger: @nestjs/swagger (^11.4.7); api/src/swagger.ts setupSwagger() serves the UI at /api/docs and the document at /api/docs-json with a bearer security scheme; auth/tasks/health controllers and request DTOs annotated. README documents envelopes, Swagger, env validation, run/configure/test. Tests updated to the envelope; new test/api-docs.e2e-spec.ts asserts every path is documented. Validation in api/: npm run format:check, lint, typecheck, build PASS; npm test -> 36 passed (8 suites); npm run test:e2e -> 22 passed (4 suites). Real built-server smoke (throwaway postgres:17-alpine host 55432, node dist/main.js on 3003): GET /api/v1/health -> {success,statusCode:200,data:{status:'ok',...}}; unknown route -> {success:false,statusCode:404,...,path}; /api/docs -> 200 and /api/docs-json lists all 8 paths + bearer scheme; register -> 201 {data.user,data.accessToken} with no hash, create/list -> data + data.meta, bad login -> 401 same message, invalid title -> 400 {message:[...]}, no auth -> 401; missing DATABASE_URL/JWT_SECRET -> exit 1 with 'Missing required environment variable(s): ...'. api commit ec1a4614a145b44d8b6a0acc24b80a6c11027088 on branch ralph/task-007-api-polish.

tasks.title: Scaffold the Next.js web service with Docker
tasks.description: Create the Next.js (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind) web repo with a standalone-output multi-stage Dockerfile, and add the web service to the root docker-compose.
acceptanceCriteria: The web app builds and runs; the home route renders.
The Dockerfile builds a minimal standalone image and serves the app as a non-root user.
docker compose up serves the web service alongside api and postgres.
The project's lint, type-check, and build commands pass.
tasks.notes: Scaffolded the web/ Next.js 15.5.27 repo (App Router, TypeScript 5.9, React 19.3, Tailwind CSS v4 via @tailwindcss/postcss) with ESLint flat config + Prettier. Home route '/' renders a landing page (src/app/layout.tsx + page.tsx + globals.css + icon.svg). next.config.ts sets output:'standalone' and outputFileTracingRoot:__dirname (a stray lockfile in the developer home dir otherwise made Next infer the wrong tracing root and nest the standalone output). Dockerfile is multi-stage (deps -> build -> runner): copies .next/standalone + .next/static + public into /app and runs `node server.js` as non-root uid/gid 1001 (web) on port 3000 with a HEALTHCHECK. Scripts: dev, build, start, lint (ESLint flat config via the CLI, not the deprecated `next lint`), typecheck (tsc --noEmit), format:check. Validation in web/: npm run format:check PASS, lint PASS, typecheck PASS; npm run build PASS (routes /, /_not-found, /icon.svg). Standalone smoke: `node .next/standalone/server.js` -> GET / 200 with <title>Task Board</title>, /icon.svg 200. Docker image (`docker compose build web`) runs as uid=1001(web), GET / 200, HEALTHCHECK healthy. Full stack (`docker compose -p taskboard -f docker-compose.yml -f <scratch port override> up -d --build`; host 5432 is held by an unrelated container so a scratch override remapped db to 55432, committed compose unchanged): db + api + web all healthy, GET localhost:3001/api/v1/health -> 200 {success:true,...}, GET localhost:3000/ -> 200 <title>Task Board</title>. web commit d411b87 on branch ralph/task-008-web-scaffold. Notes: `next build` fails if NODE_ENV is forced to 'development' (prerender of /404 throws '<Html> should not be imported outside of pages/_document'); build under the standard production NODE_ENV. The machine exports NODE_ENV=production, so install dev deps with `NODE_ENV=development npm install --include=dev`. The committed docker-compose.yml web service (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL, port 3000) was already present and is unchanged.

tasks.title: Add the API client and authentication token handling
tasks.description: Add a typed API client that injects the bearer token, refreshes once on 401 via /auth/refresh, and clears auth on refresh failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Requests to the API include the access token when present.
A 401 triggers exactly one refresh attempt, then retries the original request.
A failed refresh clears auth state and redirects to /login.
The client is covered by tests.
tasks.notes: Added a typed API client in web/src/lib/api (client.ts, errors.ts, token-store.ts, types.ts, index.ts). ApiClient unwraps the {success,statusCode,data} envelope and returns data; attaches the in-memory access token as 'Authorization: Bearer ...' when present (header omitted otherwise); always sends credentials:'include' so the refresh cookie reaches POST /auth/refresh; auto-sets Content-Type: application/json for JSON bodies. A 401 triggers exactly one refresh (single-flight: concurrent 401s share one refreshPromise) then retries the original request with the new token; the retry cannot itself refresh, so a second 401 throws instead of looping. A failed refresh clears the token store, calls onUnauthenticated (default redirectToLogin -> window.location.assign('/login')), and throws the structured ApiError. register/login/refresh/logout bypass the refresh flow so invalid credentials surface as a 401 ApiError with no redirect. ApiError exposes statusCode/error/messages[]/path. Typed methods: register, login, logout, me, listTasks(page/limit/completed), createTask, getTask, updateTask, deleteTask; exported apiClient singleton (baseUrl from NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL) + authTokenStore. Tests: Jest 29 + ts-jest 29 (@types/jest) configured in package.json (node env, testRegex .spec.tsx) with tsconfig.jest.json (CJS override) + new `npm test`/`test:watch` scripts; 12 specs in src/lib/api/client.spec.ts cover token injection/omission, single refresh + retry, no second refresh, auth clearing + redirect on refresh failure, shared concurrent refresh, structured 400 ApiError, no-refresh login, token storage on login, body/query serialization, 204. Validation in web/ (machine exports NODE_ENV=production): npm test -> 12 passed (1 suite); npm run typecheck, lint, format:check, build all PASS. web commit 7e2461ec445fed1c4c09e37f93725e793a755cf7 on branch ralph/task-009-web-api-client. Notes: the access token is held in memory only (not persisted), so a page reload relies on the refresh cookie via the 401->refresh path (TASK-010 restores the session through /auth/me); the API (api/src/main.ts) does not enable CORS yet, which TASK-010/compose need for browser calls from localhost:3000 -> localhost:3001.

tasks.title: Add registration, login, and protected routing
tasks.description: Add register and login pages, an auth provider that restores the session via /auth/me, and middleware that redirects unauthenticated users away from the task board.
acceptanceCriteria: The register and login forms submit and display validation errors accessibly.
Login failures are shown without clearing the email field.
Authenticated users land on the task board; unauthenticated users are redirected to login.
The flow is verified in the browser and relevant checks pass.
tasks.notes: Added the web auth layer (web/src/lib/auth): AuthProvider + useAuth() restore the session via GET /auth/me (transparent refresh through the httpOnly cookie) and expose login/register/logout; AuthProvider wraps the app via src/app/providers.tsx. Accessible /login and /register pages (src/app/login, src/app/register) share src/components/FormField.tsx: labeled inputs, aria-invalid/aria-describedby, inline role='alert' field errors, and a form-level alert that keeps the entered email on a failed login (401) and shows a 409 message on duplicate register. Validation (src/lib/auth/validation.ts) mirrors the API DTOs (email format, name 1..100, password 8..72). Routing: src/middleware.ts redirects unauthenticated /board -> /login and authenticated /, /login, /register -> /board, driven by a readable tb_session cookie (src/lib/auth/session.ts) set on auth and cleared on logout/refresh failure, because the API refresh cookie is httpOnly and path-scoped to /api/v1/auth. src/app/board/page.tsx is the protected shell (TASK-011 fills the list). Fix: web/src/lib/api/client.ts now binds fetch to the global (fetch.bind(globalThis)) - calling this.fetchImpl(...) threw 'TypeError: Illegal invocation' in the browser (latent since TASK-009; its unit tests inject a fetch mock so they missed it). Validation in web/: npm run format:check, lint, typecheck PASS; npm test -> 30 passed (4 suites: 18 new auth specs + 12 api-client); npm run build PASS (routes /, /login, /register, /board + middleware 34.3kB). Browser-verified end to end (real NestJS API on 3101 behind a scratch CORS-adding proxy on 3001 + throwaway postgres:17-alpine on 55432, `next start` on 3000, agent-browser): unauth /board -> /login; failed login shows 'Incorrect email or password' and retains the email; register empty submit shows 3 role=alert errors, invalid email/short password show 2 errors with aria-invalid; valid register -> /board 'Signed in as Ada Lovelace'; tb_session set; reload restores the session via /auth/me; logout -> /login with the cookie cleared; login with valid credentials -> /board. web commit 6b14559 on branch ralph/task-010-web-auth. Note: `next dev` (Turbopack/webpack eval) fails in this sandbox with 'Code generation from strings disallowed' for the middleware bundle, so the browser check used `next start` on the production build; and the API still has no CORS (browser calls 3000->3001 are blocked), so the browser check used a temporary CORS proxy - the real CORS enablement belongs to TASK-014.

tasks.title: Build the task board list view
tasks.description: Render the authenticated user's tasks with loading, empty, and error states, using the API client and TanStack Query.
acceptanceCriteria: The board lists the current user's tasks from the API.
Loading, empty, and error states are each rendered appropriately.
The list is responsive and keyboard accessible.
The view is verified in the browser and relevant checks pass.
tasks.notes: Built the /board task list (web/src/components/TaskList.tsx + TaskListView.tsx) on TanStack Query 5.104.2 (@tanstack/react-query), with a QueryClientProvider (retry:1, refetchOnWindowFocus:false) added beside AuthProvider in src/app/providers.tsx. TaskList runs useQuery keyed by user id (['tasks', userId], to prevent cross-user cache leakage) calling client.listTasks({ limit: 100 }) through the shared apiClient; TaskListView renders role='status' loading, role='alert' + 'Try again' retry on error (message via taskErrorMessage), a 'No tasks yet' empty placeholder, and a semantic <ul aria-label='Your tasks'> (title, optional description, optional due date, Open/Completed badge). Responsive (flex-col -> sm:flex-row; computed flexDirection column@390px / row@1280px) and keyboard accessible (native ul/button + aria-label). Tests: TaskListView.spec.tsx (renderToStaticMarkup: loading/error/empty/list + due date) and TaskList.spec.ts (query key, error message) -> npm test 38 passed (6 suites, +8). Validation in web/: format:check, lint, typecheck all PASS; npm run build PASS (routes /, /login, /register, /board 6.29kB). Browser-verified (agent-browser; `next start` on 3000 against a built NestJS API on 3101 behind a scratch CORS proxy on 3001 + throwaway postgres:17-alpine on 55432): register -> /board empty state; 3 tasks created via API -> reload lists them newest-first with Completed/Open badges + description + 'Due Feb 3, 2026'; simulated /tasks 500 -> role=alert 'We couldn't load your tasks: Simulated tasks failure' + Try again; clearing the failure and clicking Try again re-renders the list. web commit e4f8b76 on branch ralph/task-011-web-task-list. TASK-012/013 (create + actions) build on this.

tasks.title: Add task creation

tasks.title: Wire the full stack, document it, and smoke test end to end
